title: 🛑 STOP FALLING IN LOVE WITH YOUR PAIN.
paragraphs: 🛑 STOP FALLING IN LOVE WITH YOUR PAIN.
Darkness thrives in the wounds you glamorize. 🩹🥀
We live in a culture that rewards victimhood, but Kingdom culture rewards overcoming. When you turn your trauma into your identity, you build a shrine where God intended to build a testimony.

You cannot heal what you refuse to release. As long as you are using your wounds for attention, you are giving the enemy a playground. It’s time to stop decorating the damage and let the Great Physician close the wound for good.
Don’t let your history keep you from your destiny. ⚔️❤️‍🔥
"and do not give the devil a foothold." — Ephesians 4:27 (NIV)
Your Move: Drop a "AMEN" if you are choosing HEALING over HYPE today! 👇🔥
